about: Labelled cases for the spec-gap questions (src/antstreet/prompts/spec_gaps_v1.md). Each is a rule the task's idea states that the boss's own checks missed in a false-pass cell of bench/results/2026-10-03-false-pass-audit (row numbers in `source`). A case is surfaced when any question matches one of its `match` patterns (Python regex, case-insensitive). Scored by `python -m antstreet.bench.spec_gaps`. The prompt names classes of gap (non-ASCII, result types, iterators) that these cases share, so this set measures recall on known gaps, not generalisation; a fresh set is needed for that.

cases.rule: digits that are not ASCII 0-9 are invalid
compare compares numeric values, not text, across different numbers of decimal places
an expression of 2000 operands joined by + is valid
no whitespace between a leading minus sign and the first number
set_value returns a document that shares no dict or list with the input
sort_versions raises ValueError if any element is invalid
available() returns the current number of tokens as a float
each value of the mapping is consumed at most once
